quiz.q: Which statement about IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3 and newer is true?
options: You must pay before you can write Java
It is one download; core Java is free, Ultimate extras need a subscription
Community Edition is the newest version
quiz.explain: JetBrains merged Community and Ultimate into one product in 2025.3. The free part covers everything in this course.

quiz.q: What does sout + Tab produce in IntelliJ?
quiz.explain: sout is a live template that expands to System.out.println(); with the cursor between the brackets.

options: No: cannot find symbol, method sout
quiz.explain: Templates only expand in the editor when you press Tab. javac has never heard of sout.
print does not end the line. Pick println from the completion list, or use sout.

quiz.q: Which template writes the main method?
quiz.explain: psvm (public static void main) and main both expand to public static void main(String[] args) {}.

quiz.q: Where should your .java files go in an IntelliJ project?
quiz.explain: src is the source folder. Outside it IntelliJ treats the file as plain text: no Run triangle, no completion.

quiz.q: You create Gym Log with JDK 23 by mistake. What happens to void main() { IO.println("Hi"); }?
options: It is red: compact source files are only a preview in Java 23
quiz.explain: With JDK 23 and language level 23, compact source files and IO are not normal Java. Switch the project to JDK 25.

quiz.q: Which JDK do you pick in the New Project wizard for Gym Log?
quiz.explain: Gym Log uses Java 25 (LTS). JDK 23 is only for Hyperskill projects.

quiz.q: You see a red mark under some code. Which key shows IntelliJ's quick fixes on a Mac?
quiz.explain: Option+Enter (Alt+Enter on Windows) opens the quick fixes. Shift twice is Search Everywhere.
